import subprocess,re,json
unit="prediction-a2z-v4-model@A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261007-R4P2.service"
p=subprocess.run(["journalctl","--user","-u",unit,"--since","2026-10-07 21:13:18","--no-pager"],capture_output=True,text=True)
rows=[]
for line in (p.stdout or "").splitlines():
    if "SUPERVISOR_STATE" not in line or '"attempt": 5' not in line:
        continue
    rec={}
    m=re.match(r"^([A-Z][a-z]{2} \d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}) ",line)
    if m: rec["time"]=m.group(1)
    for key,pat in {
      "state":r'"state"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"',
      "reason":r'"reason"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"',
      "attempt":r'"attempt"\s*:\s*(\d+)',
      "checkpoint":r'"checkpoint"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"',
      "retry_at":r'"retry_at"\s*:\s*([0-9.]+)'
    }.items():
        m=re.search(pat,line)
        if m:
            rec[key]=int(m.group(1)) if key=="attempt" else (float(m.group(1)) if key=="retry_at" else m.group(1))
    rows.append(rec)
print("ERROR_CLASS=R4P2_ATTEMPT5_STATES",flush=True)
print("ERROR="+json.dumps(rows[-8:],separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(1)
